summary: Tested MoodFood enhancements: (1) Quick Recipes 'Use My Ingredients' and (2) Recipe detail 'Add to shopping list'. Backend (7/7 pytest passing) and full mobile-web UI flow both verified end-to-end. Registration -> Discover -> open-quick banner -> Quick screen -> typed 3 ingredients (eggs/spinach/feta) as chips, chip remove works, generate returned 3 recipes tailored to typed ingredients (all <=10 min, using eggs/spinach/feta). Tapped recipe card -> /recipe with ingredients+content passed via params. 'Add ingredients to shopping list' button appeared under recipe body; first tap showed toast 'Added 5 items to your shopping list', second tap correctly showed 'Those items are already on your list' (no duplicates). Regression: quick recipes without ingredients still works.
critical_code_review_comments: quick.tsx openRecipe passes ingredients+content in URL params; long recipes may hit URL length limits on some platforms but works in web preview.
recipe.tsx getShoppingIngredients() falls back to parsing '## Ingredients' block; works for AI markdown as tested.
seed_data_creation: Registered ephemeral users ing_test+<ts>@example.com and ing_ui+<ts>@example.com for isolated tests; shopping list rows are prefixed TEST_ for safe cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite: pytest backend/tests/test_ingredients_and_add_to_list.py. UI flow: register -> Discover FIRST step shows 10-minute meals banner (testID open-quick) -> Quick screen has testIDs quick-ingredient-input, quick-ingredient-add, quick-ing-<name>, generate-quick, recipe-card-<title>. Recipe detail add-to-list testID appears after recipeContent loads and only if ingredients >= 1.
rca_of_issue: N/A - all flows working as spec.
